verdict: Caution: lend selectively to forging and casting units with firm order books and conservative gearing; decline commodity-only rolling-mill-linked proposals until unit-level numbers are collected.
title: Mandi Gobindgarh castings & forgings: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What this business physically is
Mandi Gobindgarh is a secondary-steel cluster: about 200 rolling mills serving 25% of the country's secondary steel market, 48 induction furnaces feeding them, 12 forging units and 40 foundry units, plus 90 scrap-cutting units and 12 oxygen plants [1]. ## Where value and cash sit
Value sits in the conversion margin per kg and in the customer's approval of the part, not in tonnage. Peer Nelcast targets EBITDA of ₹15 per kg and reported Q2FY25 revenue of ₹335 crore against ₹362.6 crore a year earlier on subdued CV demand [2]. **So when a proposal lands, check the EBITDA-per-kg or per-piece conversion margin and the customer concentration; if one buyer is above a third of sales, ask for the supply agreement and payment terms.** Working capital is scrap inventory plus receivable days from mills; capex is furnace, forging press and oxygen capacity, and Arcvac's ingot and forgings expansion to 35,604 MTPA and 20,000 MTPA respectively was planned at a stated cost [8]. ## What has changed now
Demand is split. Ramkrishna Forgings grew revenue 54.9% YoY to ₹1,405 crore in Q2 FY27 with EBITDA margin at 18.23% and ₹673 crore of new orders [4]; Happy Forgings carries an order book of nearly ₹950 crore, about 60% export [3], and grew Q4 FY26 revenue 20.4% on 20.6% volume growth [5]. **The order-book-led, export-mixed forger is performing; the CV-linked, commodity caster is not.** Nelcast's muted topline on weak domestic and export CV demand [2] and a caster whose FY2025 revenue fell about 2% with OPM at 8.4% [9] show the other side. India-wide IIP for NIC 24 rose 2.4% YoY and 3.4% Apr-to-date [D]. ## Where to grow, and how to grow safely
Punjab GST collections are up 9.7% Apr-to-date against India's 6.1% [D], a genuine local tailwind; electricity demand is up 8.8% against India's 9.5% [D], neutral. **Pursue forging units with a named order book and export or non-CV diversification; avoid pure scrap-to-billet converters selling to one rolling mill.** Structure term debt to the capex commissioning date, keep a drawing-power margin, and take monthly stock-and-debtor statements, quarterly unit-level EBITDA per kg and the order-book position. Rating evidence supports this: one forging peer runs near-nil gearing with TOL/TNW at 0.3 times [6], while a caster sits at CRISIL BB/Stable with ₹72 crore of rated facilities [7]. ## Early-warning signs
- Monthly stock statement (monthly): inventory days rising while sales flat -> ask for scrap purchase invoices and cut limit. - Quarterly unit EBITDA per kg (quarterly): margin below the proposal assumption -> reprice or seek promoter infusion. - Order book and customer mix (quarterly): export or non-CV share falling -> shift to secured receivables finance only. - Electricity units consumed (monthly): furnace load dropping -> verify with CEA-state data and visit the plant.

Below proposal assumption -> reprice or seek promoter infusion
Export or non-CV share falls -> move to secured receivables finance only
Furnace load drops -> plant visit and cross-check with state power data
